subject: Vendor activation + PO metadata, billing & line-item guidance
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudforge.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudforge.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding - initial forms and PO questions

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. To get CloudForge into Redwood's vendor system we attached our standard onboarding packet (W-9 + bank ACH details). Before we upload everything to our AP system I wanted to confirm a couple items so we can match the PO to our internal workflow: 

- Preferred remit name and address to appear on the PO and invoice (we have two legal entities).
- Do you require a specific PO line-item template (unit vs. hours vs. license)? We typically bill as "license" and then add an SLA hours line item.
- Which email or portal should invoices be sent to (AP@redwood.com or Coupa integration)?
- Any required GL or charge codes we should include on our invoices so they auto-route?

Attached: CloudForge_W9.pdf, bank_details_redacted.pdf (we will send full bank ACH too).

If it helps we can hop on a 20-min call this week to speed things up.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Procurement
CloudForge

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudforge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - initial forms and PO questions

Hi Aisha —

Thanks, appreciate the packet. Quick answers / next steps from our side:

- Remit entity: please make PO and invoices to "CloudForge, Inc." or confirm if you need them to go to CloudForge Global LLC — we will accept either but need the legal name to match the W-9.
- Line-item guidance: we prefer one line per deliverable to make reconciliation simpler. For SaaS licenses use: "Subscription - Redwood Inference Platform (seat/month)" as the unit description; for professional services use "Professional Services - Implementation (hours)" with a qty/hour UOM. Avoid compound lines that mix license + services in one row.
- Invoice submission: AP@redwood.com is the primary inbound address. We also support Coupa punchout for larger partners — let me loop procurement on that.
- GL codes: we usually require a 6-digit cost center code; procurement/finance will provide the exact code once supplier record is created. If you include your internal PO number in the invoice header that speeds matching.

Laura / Marissa — can you confirm the PO issuance timeline and the exact PO number format we should share with CloudForge? Also, any minimum line-item detail requirements (description length, tax handling)?

If Aisha is available, a 20-min sync on Thursday afternoon would be helpful.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudforge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - initial forms and PO questions

Hi all —

Quick procurement ops notes to make the vendor activation predictable: 

1) Vendor record creation checklist (what we need to issue first PO):
   - Signed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) matched to legal entity name
   - Completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (attached) with primary contact, remit address, and bank ACH details (or vendor portal enrollment)
   - Vendor business classification (LLC / C-Corp) and VAT/TIN if outside US

2) PO format and line-item rules: 
   - PO header will include: PO number (RWI-YYYY-#####), vendor legal name, remit address, tax terms, and payment terms.
   - Line items: one deliverable per line; fields we require from vendor: description (max 200 chars), unit (UNIT / HOUR / LICENSE), quantity, unit price, start/end dates if subscription-based, and optionally SOW reference number.
   - Tax handling: Redwood does not automatically remit vendor sales tax; vendor should indicate if tax is included on invoice. If applicable, we will add tax lines per invoice reconciliation rules.
   - Attach any SOW or statement-of-work as a referenced document (DocRef: RWI-SOW-xxxx) rather than embedding SOW text in the line description to keep PO parsing stable.

3) Timeline: typical turnaround once we have completed vendor record + signed SOW: 3-7 business days to generate and route PO for approval; if a contract requires Exec approval or non-standard T&Cs, add 7-10 business days.

4) Invoicing endpoint: AP@redwood.com. For Coupa integration please indicate "Coupa: yes" on the onboarding form so we can prioritize punchout setup.

5) GL / cost center: we will assign a 6-digit cost center after purchase requisition; please include your internal invoice number on submission.

Aisha — after you confirm remit name and send the completed vendor_onboarding_form we will create the vendor record and push a PO. If you need an expedited PO earlier (e.g., to start onboarding tasks) request an "expedite" note in the form and copy me — we will evaluate to shorten to 1-2 business days when possible.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudforge.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - initial forms and PO questions

Hi Aisha —

A couple finance items to confirm before we issue PO: 

- Please confirm vendor TIN (exact match to W-9) and whether CloudForge is eligible for net-30 terms. Standard Redwood terms are Net 30 from invoice date unless explicitly negotiated.
- If you want early-pay discount options (1.5%/10 Net 30, etc.) include that in the onboarding form; we'll review as part of commercial terms.
- Invoice attachment requirements: we require an invoice PDF with PO number on the header, line-item prices matching PO and any tax lines shown separately. Supporting documentation (timesheets for PS hours) should be attached as separate PDFs and referenced by filename.

Once we receive the completed onboarding form and verification, I will route for final sign-off and the PO will be issued with the RWI-2026-##### format. Expect the issuance window Laura outlined (3-7 business days). If legal flags non-standard T&Cs, we'll loop in Karthik and that will extend timeline.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudforge.com>

Thanks everyone — quick update from CloudForge: 

- Remit legal name: "CloudForge, Inc." (matches attached W-9).
- Completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (attached) and full bank ACH form sent to Laura directly via secure link.
- We prefer invoice submission to AP@redwood.com; please confirm if Coupa is required for initial onboarding.
- We accept Net 30. We can also offer 1% 14-day early-pay for the first 6 months as part of our onboarding incentive if Redwood wants to consider it.

Can you confirm the expected earliest PO issuance date so we can schedule implementation kickoff? CloudForge is ready to begin provisioning services on Jan 4, 2027 if a PO is in place by Dec 28, 2026.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan

CloudForge

Aisha —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the early-pay offer. Summary / commitments from Redwood: 

- We received the W-9 and completed onboarding form and will finalize the vendor record today.
- Finance (Marissa) will perform TIN match; once verified we will queue the PO. Target issuance window: Dec 22-28, 2026 (3-7 business days as described). If legal/contract review is required we will notify you immediately.
- PO format: RWI-2026-#####. Example: RWI-2026-01234. Please include that PO number on invoices.
- Line-item guidance recap: one deliverable per row; include description, UOM (UNIT/HOUR/LICENSE), qty, unit price, start/end dates for subscriptions, and SOW reference (RWI-SOW-xxxx).
- Invoicing endpoint: AP@redwood.com. Coupa is optional; mark "Coupa: yes" on the form if you want punchout setup.

Next steps: Laura will confirm when vendor record is active and send the PO number when issued. If you need us to expedite to meet the Dec 28 start date, reply to this thread with "EXPEDITE" in the subject and we will prioritize.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
